text: Free RPG demo where you don't fight. You program your party.
You wire up little logic nodes, like: find the ally with the lowest HP, and heal them.
Send your golems up the tower, and they battle on their own.
They lose. You fix the nodes. You try again.
Best part? The music is by Yuzo Koshiro, a legend of that Genesis synth sound.
The catch? The dungeon sits in a small window, and menus fill the rest of the screen.
Forty-five of its forty-six Steam reviews are positive, and it's published by Raw Fury.
Think Final Fantasy Twelve's gambits, turned into a whole game.
Worth a dip if debugging sounds like fun.
